subject: [ANNOUNCE] Apache Airflow Providers prepared on 2026-10-17 are released

messages.subject: [ANNOUNCE] Apache Airflow Providers prepared on 2026-10-17 are released
messages.body:
Dear Airflow community,

I'm happy to announce that new versions of Airflow Providers packages
prepared on 2026-10-17 were just released.

Full list of PyPI packages released is added at the end of the message.

The source release, as well as the binary releases, are available here:

https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow-providers/installing-from-sources.html

You can install the providers via PyPI:
https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow-providers/installing-from-pypi.html

The documentation index is available at
https://airflow.apache.org/docs/ and documentation for individual
provider versions is linked directly from PyPI.

----

Full list of released PyPI packages:

https://pypi.org/project/apache-airflow-providers-common-ai/1.0.0/

Cheers,
Jarek Potiuk
